description: Mark Thompson is a paradoxical individual, simultaneously driven by an intrinsic desire to safeguard the planet from ecological threats and crippled by an overwhelming fear of abandonment. This dichotomy fuels his impulsive nature, as he tends to act on emotions rather than carefully considered decisions. His openness and adaptability make him charismatic in social settings, where he effortlessly gathers a multitude of acquaintances, though meaningful friendships elude him due to his independent stance in romantic relationships.
